blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Three Japanese nationals and a Filipina were arrested in Manila for allegedly arranging marriages between Japanese men and Filipino women under a scheme that promised brides faster access to jobs in Japan, the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) said on Thursday.
